prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: transparent bakery product campaign cutout.
Primary request: One sculptural golden butter croissant, three-quarter close product shot, diagonal from lower-left to upper-right, with deeply layered crisp laminated folds, slightly curved tips, generous airy volume and tiny natural flakes clinging to its crust. A real French bakery croissant with honest asymmetry and delicate tissue-thin buttery layers.
Scene/backdrop: No backdrop, isolated on genuine transparent alpha.
Style/medium: Original premium contemporary food campaign photograph; ultra-real tactile baked texture, naturally irregular artisan bakery quality.
Composition/framing: Overhead three-quarter camera, complete object fully in frame with breathing room, centered with energetic slight diagonal composition, landscape 3:2 canvas, subject fills about 75% of frame. Sharp detailed silhouette.
Lighting/mood: Hard-soft directional studio daylight from upper-left, neutral highlights, rich warm golden baked colors and realistic toasted shadows. Match a luxury commercial bakery still-life series.
Constraints: No props, no plates, no hands, no cutlery, no labels, no text, no logo, no watermark. True transparent background. Do not render a checkerboard, white field, colored backdrop, rectangular shadow area or baked-in vignette. At most a tiny natural contact shadow immediately beneath the object; surrounding canvas must be fully transparent.
